description: DAB converter. Watch ZVS loss, phase-shift hunting, and circulating current.

pathologies.explanation: High-frequency oscillation — likely ZVS loss causing switching noise. At light load or small phase shift, ZVS is lost. Switch to EPS or TPS modulation.
Output oscillates slowly — the phase-shift command is hunting. The nonlinear P(phi) relationship causes gain variation. Reduce kp or add nonlinear gain compensation.
DC output is correct but ripple is high — circulating current from SPS modulation at light load. Switch to EPS or TPS to reduce circulating current.
Output never approaches target — implementation error (phase-shift command not reaching the bridges, or wrong timer mapping).
